<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/auth/me/calendar-feed"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Whether you currently have a calendar subscription URL. The URL itself
is never returned here — the server stores only a SHA-256 hash of its
secret, so it can't be read back. Create a new one to get a URL again.

Session-authenticated requests only — a personal access token gets a
`403`.
